---
title: "Township Reports"
page-layout: full
---

Search for a township below and open its report. Township reports summarize the commercial and industrial PINs and projects located within each township.

Because projects may cross municipal or township boundaries, report counts are not additive across geographies.

```{r}
#| label: township-directory
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(DT)

slugify <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("^-") |>
    str_remove("-$")
}

comm_ind <- read_csv(
  "../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/comm_ind_PINs_2011to2022_timeseries.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(year == 2022) |>
  mutate(pin = as.character(pin))

keypins <- read_xlsx(
  "../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/projects_checked_MAINFILE.xlsx"
) |>
  transmute(
    pin = as.character(pin),
    keypin = as.character(main_keypin)
  ) |>
  distinct(pin, keypin)

township_directory <- comm_ind |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Township), Township != "",
    Township != "Chicago"
  ) |>
  left_join(keypins, by = "pin") |>
  group_by(Township) |>
  summarise(
    `C&I PINs` = n_distinct(pin),
    Projects = n_distinct(keypin, na.rm = TRUE),
    Municipalities = n_distinct(clean_name, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Township) |>
  mutate(
    Report = paste0(
      '<a href="townships/', slugify(Township),
      '-projects.html">Open report</a>'
    )
  )

DT::datatable(
  township_directory,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    searchHighlight = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
)
```
